## Maintainer checklist

Quote the generated section of templates/<login>/<id>/README.md for each template that changed.

- [ ] The generated summary matches what the template does.
- [ ] Every non-default setting has a `references` link that says so.
- [ ] No vendor name or logo is implied for an unaffiliated publisher. The plugin does not raise the identity finding for a bundled template, so this check is the only one: a label, API name or logo that names a vendor is accepted only for that vendor's own template, such as `SalesforceHostedMcp`, described as for the Hosted MCP servers run by Salesforce.
- [ ] Callback hosts belong to the platform.
- [ ] No personal data defaults.
- [ ] The description does not describe configuration.
- [ ] The template version is higher than before.
